annotations.title: Publish a new version of a page

description: Replace an HTML page on HTMLAnnotate with a new version, on the same review link, so the client sees the update without a new link. The new version starts with no comments; earlier versions keep theirs. Use after making the changes from get_comments. Needs the manage link. Only for pages shared as HTML, not live websites.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page.

note.description: Optional short note for that email, like what changed.

notify_reviewers.description: Email everyone who commented that a new version is ready. Ask the user first.

name: update_page
